lines: Plans change after a Popkin starts. Now the Host can change it too.
Mara hosts Lakeside Weekend. In Popkin settings she has four choices: edit the name and look, change how long it lasts, invite people, and wrap up.
The weekend is running long. She renames it Lakeside Long Weekend, picks the party popper and plum.
She saves, and the home shows the new name and colour at once.
Clear the name, and the field asks you to give your Popkin a name.
How long should it last? The weekend is chosen, so she picks Until a date: Monday at six.
The time left now reads two days, six hours.
And everyone sees it. On another member's screen, the name, the colour and the time left change without a reload.
In the last hour, the Host's Change on the banner opens the same choice.

lines.text: On a phone, the dialog is a sheet from the bottom.
On a bigger screen, it sits in the middle.

lines: What no screen shows: only the Host may change it, a wrapped-up Popkin can't be changed, and a late change never undoes a newer one.
Still to come: the Popkin's own address.
That is journey sixteen. Popkin is a free platform for pop-up communities.
